name: Workbench
description:
An IDE as one component: application frame, activity rail, side views, tabbed and splittable
editors, code windows, panels, menus, commands and a status bar. It fills its parent, which needs
a definite height. To use the parts in a shell you already have, start from `WorkbenchProvider`.
signature: ({ windows, brand, actions, account, views, inspector, ...provider }: WorkbenchProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: account
props.description: The end of the top bar, usually an `AccountButton`.

props.name: actions
props.description: Beside the search in the top bar, such as a theme toggle.

props.name: backend
props.description: Where files come from and what provides language features. Only `files` is needed.

props.name: createWorker
props.description: Makes a document worker. Default: the package's worker, which most bundlers can find.

props.name: inspector
props.description: A second side pane, usually an `Inspector`.

props.name: lexers
props.description: Highlighting by file extension, such as `{ ts: typescriptLexer }`.

props.name: panels
props.description: The application's own panels, beside Problems and Output.

props.name: recovery
props.description:
Where unsaved edits are kept, so a crash or a closed tab loses nothing: they are offered back
when the file next opens. Default: the browser's IndexedDB. `null` keeps none.

props.name: storageKey
props.description: Where the layout is remembered. Leave out to remember nothing.

props.name: views
props.description: The application's own views, after Explorer, Search and Changes.

props.name: windows
props.description: The window manager to open code windows in. Default: one of its own.
